industryQuestions.text: What is your Combined Ratio (Loss Ratio + Expense Ratio)?
industryQuestions.help: Combined Ratio is the sum of claims paid and expenses divided by premiums. Below 100% indicates underwriting profit. Industry average is 96-100%.
Loss Ratio = Claims Paid / Premiums Earned. Industry average is 55-70%. Lower is better.

industryQuestions.text: What is your average Underwriting Cycle Time?
industryQuestions.help: Time from application receipt to policy issuance. AI-driven insurtech targets <24 hours. Traditional: 3-7 days.

industryQuestions.text: What is your Claims Settlement Time?
industryQuestions.help: Average days from claim filing (FNOL) to settlement. Industry average: 30-45 days. Leading insurtech: <10 days.

industryQuestions.text: What level of AI/ML automation do you have in underwriting?
industryQuestions.help: AI-driven underwriting can reduce processing time by 80% and improve loss ratios by 1-3%.

options.text: Full AI underwriting with human oversight

industryQuestions.text: Do you use IoT/Telematics data for risk assessment?
industryQuestions.help: Real-time data from wearables, smart homes, or vehicle telematics can reduce claim losses by 20%.

industryQuestions.text: What is your Fraud Detection Rate?
industryQuestions.help: Insurance fraud costs $40B annually in the US. AI-driven fraud detection reduces fraudulent claims by 30%.

industryQuestions.text: What is your Quote-to-Bind Conversion Rate?
industryQuestions.help: Percentage of quotes that convert to policies. Industry average: 15-25%. Top performers: 30%+.

industryQuestions.text: What is your Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)?
industryQuestions.help: Cost to acquire one new policyholder. Insurtech targets $50-$200 vs traditional $300-$1000.
Operational expenses / Premiums Earned. Industry average: 25-30%. Lower indicates efficiency.

industryQuestions.text: Do you have Straight-Through Processing (STP) for claims?
industryQuestions.help: STP automates simple claims without human intervention, reducing costs by 40-60%.

industryQuestions.text: What is your Policy Renewal Rate?
industryQuestions.help: Percentage of policies renewed. Industry average: 75-85%. Best-in-class: 90%+.

industryQuestions.text: Do you have an API-first platform?
industryQuestions.help: API-first architecture enables partnerships, embedded insurance, and ecosystem growth.

industryQuestions.text: Have you achieved regulatory compliance (state licenses, data privacy)?
industryQuestions.help: Insurance is heavily regulated. Compliance with state regulations and GDPR/CCPA is critical.

industryQuestions.text: What is your Retention Ratio (premiums retained vs reinsured)?
industryQuestions.help: Higher retention = more risk but higher profit potential. Typical: 60-80% retention.
